Council Meetings

Ordinary Council Meetings are generally held on the second Tuesday of each month (excluding January), commencing at 6.30pm.

After each Council meeting, the audio visual recording is checked by the livestreaming provider and then indexed to allow convenient direct access to individual agenda items. The indexed recording of the meeting will be available on the Friday following the meeting. The recording will be retained on Council's website for a period of 12 months after the date of the meeting.

All Council meetings are also live-streamed here.
